hookups.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/hog-island-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120169 (all 20 RV-or-tent sites: 'Water Hookup: Y'; no electric or sewer attribute) + FDACS Croom Tract page ('Primitive campsites with water, picnic table and fire ring'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 20 RV-or-tent sites (19 take 25 ft, one 20 ft) and one tent-only site, all back-in; shaded and screened from one another by understory vegetation.

sites.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/hog-island-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120169 ('21 site(s) found'; Max Vehicle Length 25 at 19 sites, 20 at one; Access Type 'Back-In' at all 20 RV-or-tent sites) + FDACS Croom Tract page ('beautiful shaded campsites that are screened from one another by natural understory vegetation'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: FDACS Croom Tract page (Facilities: 'Dump station for registered campers', 'Restrooms and showers', 'Canoe and boat launch') + ReserveAmerica site details ('Water Available: Potable'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bookable for the same day and up to 11 months ahead. Youth group camp by reservation too.

booking.source: https://floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com/camping/hog-island-campground-withlacoochee-state-forest/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120169 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance.'; every site 'Site-Specific') + https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Withlacoochee-State-Forest/Recreation-at-Withlacoochee-State-Forest/Withlacoochee-Camping-Sites ('Improved campgrounds require reservations through ReserveAmerica.', Hog Island Campground listed), read 2026-10-21

summary: ReserveAmerica (FLFS) and the FDACS Croom Tract page: confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica (11-month window, reservations required), open year round, 21 sites (20 RV-or-tent to 25 ft, all back-in), water at the site, showers/dump/potable water. Fees ($13.76, read 2026-10-12) left. Not stated: electric (none listed but no explicit 'no'), sewer, flush toilets. Note kept.
flags: Fit is tight: max vehicle length 25 ft at 19 of 20 RV sites (20 ft at site 004); EKKO's 23 ft fits.

Missing agency website: the entry links only ReserveAmerica; the Florida Forest Service's page for it is https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Withlacoochee-State-Forest/Recreation-Areas-on-the-Croom-Tract-at-Withlacoochee-State-Forest (Hog Island Recreation Area section).

Name: FDACS and ReserveAmerica call it 'Hog Island Campground' (ReserveAmerica: 'Hog Island Campground Withlacoochee State Forest'); the entry's 'Hog Island Recreation Area, Campground & Kayak Launch' is not a published name.
